ownerSteering: Jared 22 November: tangible subjects in distinctive scientific image styles. Tenth world uses transmitted radiography, distinct from emitted thermal imaging.

prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. GLAZE RADIOGRAPHIC DEEPWATCH, a tangible invented abyssal observation ecology imaged by TRANSMITTED X-RAY ABSORPTION. MEDIUM: exquisite monochrome positive absorption radiograph, bone-ivory and silver-gray densities. Soft translucent tissue envelopes surround crisp overlapping internal cartilage struts, perforated trabecular supports, hollow chambers and articulated joints. The dense internal structures are brightest ivory; low-density tissue is a dim gray transparent haze. Overlapping structures accumulate density as in an authentic flattened transmission projection. Show the whole tangible subject with recognizable anatomy or mechanism, including readable hollow interior construction. No visible-light surface, reflected lighting, specular shine, glass material, chrome, wireframe, engraved lines, ordinary illustration, clay render or sculptural photograph. No coloured glow, emitted heat, rainbow, diffraction fringes, scanlines, point-cloud dots, particle trails, ultrasound speckle or medical text. Fictional nonhuman structures, not a real patient or measured diagnostic image. No human bones, injury or gore. No letters, labels, scales, numerals, clock faces, readings, graphs, logos or watermark. Asset: ONE individual square 1024x1024 pure-art widget. Subject LANTERN RAY: a tangible invented abyssal swimming creature with two wide unequal kite-shaped wings, a compact head with two dark eye apertures, a forward arched stalk carrying a hollow pear-shaped lantern organ, and a long narrow tail splitting into three unequal prongs. Broad three-quarter view; wings anatomically attach to the central torso. The radiograph reveals branching wing cartilage, jointed stalk supports, ribbed lamp chamber and a gently curved tail spine. Entire form must read as a creature, not an abstract fan or skeleton fragment. Entire subject and all extremities fit inside central 75% of canvas, generous empty margins. Real transparent alpha exterior and open gaps, no black backing, floor, cast shadow, exterior halo, tile, frame, panel or mockup. Internal translucent tissue remains visible only within the subject silhouette.
